correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the binomial thinning semigroup, cut decomposition of the complete-pair Gini seminorm and column-mass <=1/p estimate. The endpoint singleton produces the displayed sum. The linear rank-one-modulo-constants approximation has exact norm p(n+1)(n+2)/6 and a uniform O(n(n+1)(n-1)p^2/2) remainder. It yields gamma~n^2 p/6 for np->0 and gamma~1/p for np->infinity; endpoint Riemann sums show the log-n lower window and at 2 log n + s the exact limit e^{-s}/6. The stochastic-row overlap gives Dobrushin delta=1-(1-p)^n, hence ratio~n/6 in np->0. Independently enumerated all 62 nonconstant binary cuts at n=5,p=1/7, obtaining the same maximum and endpoint value 62921/84035. The finite check does not establish any all-n norm formula beyond stated bounds.
